randomStreamScope.negativeOffsets: Mathematical reversible continuation before construction; validated by forward reconstruction. No claim these are real preconstruction game draws.

historicalGoalAssociation.selection: All seven scenario1 startup cases plus first93 scenario3 startup cases sorted by replay SHA256, and all32 existing passing controls. Selection uses no placements or goal outcomes.

careerFollowup.interpretation: All new startup mismatches fail a mandatory Career goal under the captured seed. Other goal failures retain their seed. This supports investigating conditional goal-failure rerolls or result selection, but establishes neither a replacement-seed rule nor a simulator correction. No universal 70% rule is inferred.

limitations: Frozen local intake, not a moving live count.
Agreement covers recorded official observations; full simulator frames are integrity-checked, not compared with unrecorded official ticks.
Inferred Career seeds are diagnostic only; canonical inputs and failed status are unchanged.
Older unresolved cases remain open; this is not a full historical corpus rerun.
